title: GTA 6: Small Talk to Shootout in 59 Seconds 😳
youtube_title: GTA 6: Small Talk to Shootout in 59 Seconds 😳
youtube_description:
GTA 6 goes from small talk to a shootout in under a minute. In Rockstar's An Extended Look, at 13:10, two people sit in a car, one holding a phone, arguing whether the guy they're texting is a cop ("A dude could be a cop for all we know." / "He's not a cop... he's just cautious."). In the same video, 31 seconds later a man is yelling from the back seat, at 38 seconds the driver has a bandana mask on, at 50 seconds someone is shooting out of the car window, and at 59 seconds (14:09) a police truck rolls onto its side in a street shootout. The stopwatch in this Short is Rockstar's own video clock minus 13:10. Rockstar says the Extended Look was captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5.

Small talk or shootout: which part of GTA 6 are you here for?

Sources (Rockstar Games, read Nov 28, 2026):
- Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look, August 27, 2026, 13:10 to 14:09 ("Captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5"): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/an-extended-look
- Grand Theft Auto VI, out November 19, 2026: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI

The video cuts between shots, so the seconds are gaps in Rockstar's video, not one unbroken take. We don't say who the man in the back seat is or which mission this is. The stopwatch, speech bubbles and vote card are our own graphics.

Clips: Rockstar Games (Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look), used for commentary. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
